name: adaptive-prompt-architect
description: Turns noisy requests into focused prompts or finished work by reconstructing intent, using context selectively, and preserving scope.

interface.shortDescription: Turns rough intent into focused prompts or finished work
interface.longDescription: Reconstructs intent from voice transcripts, fragments, and typos; starts from the outcome; uses project context progressively; and either returns a copy-ready prompt or completes the task without prompt bloat or invented authority.
defaultPrompt: Turn my rough request into focused work without expanding its scope.
Turn my latest message into a copy-ready prompt only.
Deeply refine my latest request, then complete it without expanding its scope.
